Saint LuciaPursuant to Schedule 2, Section I(A)(1)(c), contract an external, independent private audit firm, acceptable to theAssociation, with terms of reference acceptable to the Association, no later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, who willbe mandated to conduct an audit of the Project on an annual basis.
